g.text: Attachment OBS and openGauss responsibility split
No BLOB, BYTEA, Base64, URL, or credentials.
No Object Key, ETag, or declared MIME column.
After deletion only the permanent five-field
DELETED identity row remains as an ID tombstone.
The exact Object Key equals attachment_id.
There is no prefix, directory, or file-name part.
The private bucket and authorization remain required.
Pod memory contains bounded in-flight chunks only.
There is no local file, temporary directory,
authoritative Java Map, or complete file cache.
